name: 18 - API - Block Doctor Time - Corrected V2

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS doctor_name,
        $3::DATE AS start_date,
        $4::TIME AS start_time,
        $5::DATE AS end_date,
        $6::TIME AS end_time,
        $7::TEXT AS reason,
        $8::TEXT AS source
),

doctor_context AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS clinic_id,
        c.name AS clinic_name,
        c.timezone,

        d.id AS doctor_id,
        d.full_name AS doctor_name,

        r.start_date,
        r.start_time,
        r.end_date,
        r.end_time,
        r.reason,
        r.source

    FROM request_data r

    INNER JOIN clinics c
        ON c.name = r.clinic_name
       AND c.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.clinic_id = c.id
       AND d.full_name = r.doctor_name
       AND d.is_active = TRUE

    ORDER BY d.id
    LIMIT 1
),

requested_window AS (
    SELECT
        dc.*,

        (
            dc.start_date + dc.start_time
        ) AT TIME ZONE dc.timezone AS starts_at,

        (
            dc.end_date + dc.end_time
        ) AT TIME ZONE dc.timezone AS ends_at

    FROM doctor_context dc
),

exact_existing_exception AS (
    SELECT
        se.id AS exception_id,
        se.clinic_id,
        se.doctor_id,
        se.starts_at,
        se.ends_at,
        se.reason,
        se.source,
        se.is_active,
        se.created_at

    FROM schedule_exceptions se

    INNER JOIN requested_window rw
        ON rw.doctor_id = se.doctor_id

    WHERE se.is_active = TRUE
      AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'
      AND se.starts_at = rw.starts_at
      AND se.ends_at = rw.ends_at

    ORDER BY se.id
    LIMIT 1
),

overlapping_exceptions AS (
    SELECT
        se.id AS exception_id,
        se.starts_at,
        se.ends_at,
        se.reason,
        se.source

    FROM schedule_exceptions se

    INNER JOIN requested_window rw
        ON rw.doctor_id = se.doctor_id

    WHERE se.is_active = TRUE
      AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'
      AND se.starts_at < rw.ends_at
      AND se.ends_at > rw.starts_at

    ORDER BY se.starts_at
),

inserted_exception AS (
    INSERT INTO schedule_exceptions (
        clinic_id,
        doctor_id,
        exception_type,
        starts_at,
        ends_at,
        reason,
        source,
        is_active
    )

    SELECT
        rw.clinic_id,
        rw.doctor_id,
        'unavailable',
        rw.starts_at,
        rw.ends_at,
        rw.reason,
        rw.source,
        TRUE

    FROM requested_window rw

    WHERE rw.ends_at > rw.starts_at
      AND rw.starts_at > NOW()
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM overlapping_exceptions
      )

    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        id AS exception_id,
        clinic_id,
        doctor_id,
        starts_at,
        ends_at,
        reason,
        source,
        is_active,
        created_at
),

effective_exception AS (
    SELECT
        ie.exception_id,
        ie.clinic_id,
        ie.doctor_id,
        ie.starts_at,
        ie.ends_at,
        ie.reason,
        ie.source,
        ie.is_active,
        ie.created_at,
        'created'::TEXT AS exception_origin

    FROM inserted_exception ie

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ee.exception_id,
        ee.clinic_id,
        ee.doctor_id,
        ee.starts_at,
        ee.ends_at,
        ee.reason,
        ee.source,
        ee.is_active,
        ee.created_at,
        'existing_exact_match'::TEXT AS exception_origin

    FROM exact_existing_exception ee

    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inserted_exception
    )
),

affected_appointments AS (
    SELECT
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.starts_at,
        a.ends_at,
        a.status,
        a.google_calendar_event_id,

        p.full_name AS patient_name,
        p.mobile,

        d.full_name AS doctor_name,
        s.name AS service_name,

        c.timezone

    FROM appointments a

    INNER JOIN effective_exception ee
        ON ee.doctor_id = a.doctor_id

    INNER JOIN clinics c
        ON c.id = a.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN patients p
        ON p.id = a.patient_id

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.id = a.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services s
        ON s.id = a.service_id

    WHERE a.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
      AND a.starts_at < ee.ends_at
      AND a.ends_at > ee.starts_at

    ORDER BY a.starts_at
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM doctor_context) THEN FALSE
        WHEN (
            SELECT rw.ends_at <= rw.starts_at
            FROM requested_window rw
        ) THEN FALSE
        WHEN (
            SELECT rw.starts_at <= NOW()
            FROM requested_window rw
        ) THEN FALSE
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted_exception) THEN TRUE
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exact_existing_exception) THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM doctor_context)
            THEN 'doctor_not_found'
        WHEN (
            SELECT rw.ends_at <= rw.starts_at
            FROM requested_window rw
        )
            THEN 'invalid_time_range'
        WHEN (
            SELECT rw.starts_at <= NOW()
            FROM requested_window rw
        )
            THEN 'start_time_in_past'
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted_exception)
            THEN 'schedule_exception_created'
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exact_existing_exception)
            THEN 'schedule_exception_already_exists'
        ELSE 'overlapping_schedule_exception'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM doctor_context)
            THEN 'کلینیک یا پزشک مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN (
            SELECT rw.ends_at <= rw.starts_at
            FROM requested_window rw
        )
            THEN 'زمان پایان باید بعد از زمان شروع باشد.'
        WHEN (
            SELECT rw.starts_at <= NOW()
            FROM requested_window rw
        )
            THEN 'زمان شروع مسدودسازی باید مربوط به آینده باشد.'
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted_exception)
            THEN 'بازه زمانی پزشک با موفقیت مسدود شد.'
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exact_existing_exception)
            THEN 'این بازه قبلاً مسدود شده است؛ شناسه همان بازه موجود برگردانده شد.'
        ELSE 'این بازه با یک بازه مسدود فعال دیگر هم‌پوشانی دارد.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT ee.exception_id
        FROM effective_exception ee
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS exception_id,

    r.clinic_name,
    r.doctor_name,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT TO_CHAR(
                ee.starts_at AT TIME ZONE rw.timezone,
                'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
            )
            FROM effective_exception ee
            CROSS JOIN requested_window rw
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        (
            SELECT TO_CHAR(
                rw.starts_at AT TIME ZONE rw.timezone,
                'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
            )
            FROM requested_window rw
        )
    ) AS blocked_start,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT TO_CHAR(
                ee.ends_at AT TIME ZONE rw.timezone,
                'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
            )
            FROM effective_exception ee
            CROSS JOIN requested_window rw
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        (
            SELECT TO_CHAR(
                rw.ends_at AT TIME ZONE rw.timezone,
                'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
            )
            FROM requested_window rw
        )
    ) AS blocked_end,

    r.reason,
    r.source,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
        FROM affected_appointments
    ) AS affected_appointment_count,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'appointment_id', aa.appointment_id,
                    'patient_name', aa.patient_name,
                    'mobile', aa.mobile,
                    'doctor_name', aa.doctor_name,
                    'service_name', aa.service_name,
                    'appointment_date',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            aa.starts_at AT TIME ZONE aa.timezone,
                            'YYYY-MM-DD'
                        ),
                    'start_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            aa.starts_at AT TIME ZONE aa.timezone,
                            'HH24:MI'
                        ),
                    'end_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            aa.ends_at AT TIME ZONE aa.timezone,
                            'HH24:MI'
                        ),
                    'status', aa.status,
                    'google_calendar_event_id',
                        aa.google_calendar_event_id
                )
                ORDER BY aa.starts_at
            )
            FROM affected_appointments aa
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS affected_appointments,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'exception_id', oe.exception_id,
                    'blocked_start',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            oe.starts_at AT TIME ZONE rw.timezone,
                            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
                        ),
                    'blocked_end',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            oe.ends_at AT TIME ZONE rw.timezone,
                            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
                        ),
                    'reason', oe.reason,
                    'source', oe.source
                )
                ORDER BY oe.starts_at
            )
            FROM overlapping_exceptions oe
            CROSS JOIN requested_window rw
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS overlapping_exceptions

FROM request_data r;

parameters.content:
## نسخه اصلاح‌شده V2

این نسخه اجرای دوباره همان بازه را بدون ایجاد رکورد تکراری مدیریت می‌کند.

- اگر همان بازه قبلاً ثبت شده باشد، `success=true` و همان `exception_id` برمی‌گردد.
- اگر هم‌پوشانی فقط جزئی باشد، `success=false` و فهرست `overlapping_exceptions` برمی‌گردد.
- برای Workflow شماره 20، از `exception_id` خروجی استفاده کن.
